chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

key_terms.مَكْرُوهٌ: Disliked or reprehensible (a category of fiqh ruling)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on eating too much?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this concise hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) via the chain of Abu Basir, establishing the principle of *zuhd* (asceticism) in daily sustenance. This teaching is not merely about physical health but serves as a spiritual discipline to prevent the heart from becoming heavy with worldly attachment, thereby facilitating greater focus on worship and divine remembrance.
